papers.title: When Code Crosses Borders: A Security-Centric Study of LLM-based Code Translation
papers.abstractOneWord: 评估大模型跨语言代码翻译是否引入或保留漏洞，对象是 Java、PHP、C/C++ 安全相关代码。
papers.abstract: 跨语言代码迁移很常见，大模型也被用来自动做代码翻译。已有评测多看语法和功能是否正确，翻译过程会不会引入或保留漏洞，此前缺少系统测量。本文做了一项以安全为中心的经验研究：在 720 个安全相关样本上评了 5 个主流大模型，覆盖 Java、PHP、C、C++ 和 9 类 CWE。结果显示安全明显变差，28.6% 到 45% 的翻译会引入新漏洞；Web 相关缺陷，尤其是输入校验，对模型最难。作者把出错原因归成 5 类，并给出一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的缓解方法，把漏洞引入率降低了 32.8%。这是首个大规模证据，说明大模型代码翻译存在严重安全风险，也说明用知识增强的提示有可能减轻这些问题。
papers.abstractEn: Code translation is crucial for cross-language codebase migration, and large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising technique to automate this process. However, the security implications of using LLMs for code translation remain largely unexplored, as existing evaluations primarily focus on syntactic and functional correctness. To bridge this gap, we conduct a security-centric empirical study to investigate the risks of vulnerabilities being introduced or preserved during LLM-based translation. Our study involves a rigorous evaluation of five state-of-the-art LLMs on a curated dataset of 720 security-related code samples across four programming languages (Java, PHP, C, C++) and nine Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories. The results reveal significant security degradation, with 28.6% to 45% of translations introducing new vulnerabilities. Web-related flaws, particularly in input validation, proved most challenging for LLMs. Furthermore, we identify and categorize the root causes of these vulnerable translations into a taxonomy of five major error types. Based on our findings, we develop and evaluate a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)-based mitigation strategy, which successfully reduces the vulnerability introduction rate by 32.8%. Our study provides the first large-scale evidence of serious security risks in LLM-based code translation and demonstrates the potential of knowledge-enhanced prompting to mitigate them.

papers.title: Reva: Real-Time Vulnerability Detection through Contextual Probing of Large Language Models
papers.abstractOneWord: 用大模型内部表示做实时漏洞检测，对象是函数级代码（PrimeVul）。
papers.abstract: 漏洞发现得越晚，修复成本越高。编码智能体写代码的速度已经超过人工审查，软件需要能实时筛每个新函数的第一道防线。大模型智能体最近已经能像安全专家一样找真实漏洞：跑分析工具、看周围代码、验证假设、再下判断。但这套推理要很多次模型调用，每条结论要好几分钟，没法做实时筛查。更快的检测器靠微调深度学习模型或直接让大模型给结论，准确率更低：它们看不到智能体收集到的上下文，即便给一部分上下文，模型自己写出的结论也不稳。本文提出 REVA（REal-time Vulnerability Analysis）：把智能体检测器背后的安全上下文和代码理解，压进大模型的一次前向计算。对每个新函数，REVA 给模型提供该模块预先算好的威胁模型、轻量静态分析结果和调用图信息，再用训练好的探针读取模型在这一上下文里对该函数的内部表示。在 PrimeVul 留出测试集上，REVA 配 GLM-5.3-Flash 约 1 秒一个函数，准确率 60.0%，与同模型上的智能体检测器 VulTriage（59.2%）相当，速度高 250 倍以上，成本不到十分之一。同一提示下，探针比模型自己的直接结论高 14 到 17 个百分点。三个开源大模型上，REVA 都不低于 VulTriage，其中两个大约高 10%。这说明大模型内部表示已经编码了智能体检测器靠推理才拿到的很多信息。
papers.abstractEn: A vulnerability costs more to fix the later it is discovered. As coding agents generate code faster than developers can review it, software needs a first line of defense screening each new function in real time. LLM agents have recently become capable of finding real-world vulnerabilities by working as a security expert would: they run analysis tools, explore the surrounding code, test hypotheses and weigh the evidence before forming their own judgement. This reasoning, however, spans many model calls, so that each verdict takes minutes of compute, far too long for real-time screening. Faster detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, are less accurate: they judge a function without the context an agent gathers, and an LLM's generated verdict is unreliable even when given some of it. We present REVA (REal-time Vulnerability Analysis), an AI vulnerability detector that brings the security context and code understanding components behind agentic detectors into a single forward pass of an LLM. For each new function, REVA gives the LLM a pre-computed threat model of its module, lightweight static analysis findings and call-graph information. REVA leverages a trained probe to read the LLM's internal representations of the new function in this context. On PrimeVul's held-out test set, REVA on GLM-5.3-Flash reaches 60.0% accuracy in about one second per function. This matches VulTriage (59.2%), the state-of-the-art agentic detector, run on the same LLM, while being over 250 times faster and less than a tenth as costly. On the same prompt, the probe is 14% to 17% more accurate than the LLM's own direct verdict. Across three open LLMs, REVA is at least as accurate as VulTriage, and about 10% more accurate on two of them. An LLM's internal representations thus encode much of what agentic detectors obtain through reasoning.

papers.title: SemWeaver: Refining LLM-Generated Static Vulnerability Checkers with Analyzer-Internal Evidence
papers.abstractOneWord: 用分析器内部证据改进大模型生成的静态漏洞检查器，对象是 Linux 内核补丁。
papers.abstract: 已有工作表明，大模型可以根据安全补丁合成静态分析检查器，但能编译不等于正确。补丁只说明改了什么，不说明为什么这样改才安全，因此生成的检查器常常只对上表面改动，漏掉更深的语义条件。现有 refinement 循环会回馈编译错误和验证报告，这些信号描述的是症状，解释不了检查器对代码理解错在哪里。作者观察到，分析框架本身已经算出了补上这一缺口所需的信息：控制流图、符号值、内存区域和检查器回调都在分析器内部，现有 refinement 策略却没用。SemWeaver 是一层即插即用的 refinement：抽出与补丁相关的分析器证据，再和源码上下文、验证反馈拼成带出处标注的结构化包。迭代编辑循环会在漏洞版本和已修复版本上同时 refinement 检查器，并用保留门槛接受告警恢复或误报下降，同时防止过度裁剪。在 39 个由 KNighter 从 Linux 内核修复导出的 CSA 检查器上，加入分析器证据后，refinement 能在 23 个漏洞版本上打出告警（KNighter 循环是 15 个），版本级 F1 从 0.448 升到 0.575。去掉内部证据的消融实验恢复的静默案例更少，改出的检查器也不同。补充实验覆盖 12 个对象上的三种编辑模型、一次 CodeQL 查询 refinement，以及受控的源码形式变化。
papers.abstractEn: Recent work shows that LLMs can synthesize static-analysis checkers from security patches, but a compilable checker is not necessarily a correct one. A patch reveals what changed, not why the change is safe, so generated checkers often match only the surface edit and miss the deeper semantic condition. Existing refinement loops feed back compilation errors and validation reports, yet these signals describe symptoms without explaining what the checker misunderstands about the code. We observe that the analysis framework itself already computes the information needed to close this gap. Control-flow graphs, symbolic values, memory regions and checker callbacks are available inside the analyzer but unused by current refinement strategies. SemWeaver is a plug-in refinement layer that extracts patch-relevant analyzer evidence and assembles it with source context and validation feedback into a structured, provenance-labelled bundle. An iterative editing loop refines the checker on both the vulnerable and fixed revisions, guarded by a retention gate that accepts warning recovery or false-positive reduction while preventing over-pruning. We evaluate SemWeaver on 39 KNighter-derived CSA checkers from Linux kernel fixes. With analyzer evidence, refinement reaches 23 warning-positive vulnerable revisions (vs. 15 for KNighter's loop) and raises version-level F1 from 0.448 to 0.575. An ablation removing internal evidence recovers fewer silent cases and produces different checker edits, indicating that the two evidence configurations address complementary recognition gaps. Additional experiments cover three editor models on a 12-subject subset, a CodeQL query refinement, and controlled source-form variations. A qualitative follow-up on all 11 non-tied comparisons traces each warning-count change to a specific checker repair, such as recognizing a lowered callback or unwrapping an expression cast.

papers.title: Repairing Broken Access Control in Web Applications with LLMs: An Empirical Benchmark Study
papers.abstractOneWord: 用大模型修复 Web 应用中的越权漏洞，对象是四种语言的真实 Web 应用。
papers.abstract: 越权（BAC）是最严重的一类 Web 漏洞，自动修复却几乎没人做。它和内存安全漏洞不同，是逻辑漏洞，修复要理解应用的访问控制模型和业务语义，传统自动漏洞修复很难处理。大模型给了这条路一个机会，但还没有标准基准来测它们修 BAC 的能力。作者构建了 BAC-Bench：第一个 BAC 修复基准，收录 6 个常用 Web 应用、4 种语言上的 46 个真实 BAC 漏洞；每个漏洞配沙箱运行环境、PoC 验证程序和功能测试程序。他们还提出一个从位置、覆盖、机制、内容四个维度刻画 BAC 补丁的策略框架。在 BAC-Bench 上评了 8 个基础大模型和 2 个商业智能体：单轮基础模型平均修好 37.68%；加上 Apply-Feedback 和 Navigate-and-Locate 两个最小支架后，平均升到 66.03%，最好的基础模型达到 75.36%，接近最好智能体的 78.99%。有些模型补丁比官方补丁更好，其中一个还顺带修掉了一个潜伏三年的零日漏洞。
papers.abstractEn: Broken access control (BAC) ranks among the most severe web-application vulnerability classes, yet its automated repair remains largely unexplored. Unlike memory-safety vulnerabilities, BAC is a logic vulnerability whose repair demands a deep understanding of an application's access-control model and business semantics, which traditional automated vulnerability repair techniques handle poorly. Large language models (LLMs) open a promising avenue for this problem, but no standard benchmark exists for studying how well they repair BAC vulnerabilities. We construct BAC-Bench, the first benchmark for BAC repair, consisting of 46 real-world BAC vulnerabilities drawn from six widely used web applications spanning four programming languages. Each vulnerability is equipped with a sandboxed runtime environment, a PoC validation program and a functional test program. We further propose a BAC repair-strategy framework that characterizes any BAC patch along four dimensions, Position, Coverage, Mechanism, and Content. Evaluating eight base LLMs and two commercial LLM agents on BAC-Bench, we find that single-turn base LLMs repair 37.68% of the vulnerabilities on average, while two minimal scaffolds, Apply-Feedback and Navigate-and-Locate, raise this average to 66.03%, with the best base LLM reaching 75.36%, close to the 78.99% of the best agent. Notably, some LLM-generated patches surpass the official patches, and one incidentally closed a zero-day vulnerability that had lain dormant for three years. Our findings delineate the current capability boundary of LLM-based BAC repair and offer guidance toward its practical adoption.

papers.title: Can Agentic Code Review Catch Vulnerabilities Before They Are Merged?
papers.abstractOneWord: 评估智能体代码审查能否在合入前抓住漏洞，对象是 Firefox、V8、OpenSSL 等真实提交。
papers.abstract: 大模型智能体越来越多地被用来做安全向代码审查，但已有基准里的待审改动多半是从后来的修复反推出来的，不是真实引入漏洞的提交。本文提出 SecPRBench：第一个在经过验证的真实代码改动上评智能体安全审查的综合基准。作者搭了一条自动智能体流水线，从流行软件系统里采集、构建并验证大量真实引入漏洞的提交。为了评得准，还用大模型当裁判，给与真实漏洞对得上的发现记分。目前收录了 265 个任务，来自 Firefox、V8、OpenSSL 等 9 个关键系统。8 个前沿模型的召回率在 32.5% 到 78.1% 之间，Grok 4.6 和 GPT-6 sol 最高。多数漏报不是完全没看见：68% 的漏报里，智能体报了有漏洞的文件，但说的是另一种机制。面向安全的 harness 表现也不一样：OpenAI 的 Codex Security 让召回率下降 8.3 个百分点，主要是因为弃权；Anthropic 的 Defending Code 让召回率上升 7.7 个百分点，但成本更高。
papers.abstractEn: LLM agents have been increasingly adopted for security-focused code review, but existing benchmarks mostly derive the reviewed changes from their later fixes instead of the real-world bug-introducing commits. In this paper, we present SecPRBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating agentic security review on validated real-world code changes. More specifically, we have built an automated agentic pipeline to autonomously harvest, build, and validate massive real-world bug-introducing commits for popular software systems. To ensure precise evaluation, we also adopt LLM-as-a-judge to credit the findings matching ground-truth vulnerabilities. To date, we have collected 265 tasks from nine critical systems, including Firefox, V8, and OpenSSL with millions of lines of code. Across eight frontier models, recall ranges from 32.5% to 78.1%, with Grok 4.6 and GPT-6 sol ranking at the top. Our study also shows that most misses are not simply oversights: in 68% of them, the agent reports on a file that holds the flaw but argues for a different mechanism. Security-focused harnesses also behave differently: OpenAI's Codex Security lowers recall by 8.3 points, mostly by abstaining, while Anthropic's Defending Code harness raises it by 7.7 points, at a higher cost.

papers.title: Enhancing LLM-Based Vulnerability Detection via Representation-Aware Logical Ensemble
papers.abstractOneWord: 用多种代码表示上的大模型做集成漏洞检测，对象是 C 源码。
papers.abstract: 在 C 源码里自动检测漏洞是老问题：传统静态分析常常用精度换规模，复杂漏洞模式也吃力。大模型最近表现不错，但多数方法只用一种代码表示，默认它对各类漏洞都合适。本文系统研究了多种表示下的大模型漏洞检测，包括原始源码、抽象语法树（AST）和控制流图（CFG）。大量实验表明，不同表示各有所长，特定视角对特定漏洞类别更有效。基于此，作者提出表示感知逻辑集成（RALE）：用显式逻辑规则和多数投票，把在不同表示上训练的大模型合在一起。单表示模型 F1 最高 73%，集成后达到 78%，准确率、精确率和召回率都更高，并稳定超过各个单独模型。这说明把大模型用于漏洞检测时，应当显式利用互补的代码表示。
papers.abstractEn: Automated vulnerability detection in C source code is a long-standing challenge, as traditional static analysis tools often trade precision for scalability and struggle with complex vulnerability patterns. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have shown promising results; yet, most approaches rely on a single code representation, implicitly assuming uniform suitability across vulnerability types. In this work, we systematically study LLM-based vulnerability detection under multiple code representations, including raw source code, Abstract Syntax Trees (AST), and Control Flow Graphs (CFG). Through extensive empirical analysis, we show that different representations exhibit complementary strengths, with specific views being more effective for particular classes of vulnerabilities. Building on these findings, we propose a Representation-Aware Logical Ensemble (RALE) that integrates LLMs trained on different code representations through explicit logical rules and majority voting. While single-representation models achieve up to 73% F1-score, our integrated approach reaches 78% F1-score, with commensurate gains in accuracy, precision, and recall, consistently outperforming individual models. These results highlight the importance of explicitly leveraging complementary code representations when combining LLMs for effective vulnerability detection.

papers.title: Making Small Code LLMs More Efficient for Secure Code Review with Neuro-Symbolic Fine-Tuning
papers.abstractOneWord: 把小代码大模型微调成可核验的安全评审说明，对象是 C/C++ 函数。
papers.abstract: AI 编码助手写的代码越来越多，安全评审需求也在增加。现有做法有缺口：静态分析能标出程序位置但几乎不解释，语言模型的解释又不好核验。小的开源权重代码模型可以在本地做安全评审，不必把专有代码送到托管服务。本文研究微调能否让这些模型把安全证据写成开发和工具都能核对的说明。作者提出 secSemScan：静态分析器配一个可本地部署的模型，按模式写安全独白，点名程序位置、标 CWE、并给出机器可解析的结论。同时发布 OGSM（Oracle-Grounded Security Monologue）：1993 个 C/C++ 函数，覆盖污点和生命周期两类共 22 个 CWE；每条记录配分析器或修复 diff 导出的证据和一段独白。他们对三个开源权重代码模型做两阶段微调：先学输出格式，再学独白内容。因为评测提示会给出结论和证据，结果衡量的是模型会不会用这些信息，而不是它能不能独立检出漏洞。355 条测试记录上，微调把 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 的结论准确率从 4.8% 提到 96.6%；DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B 达到 78.9%，StarCoder2-7B 达到 43.7%。Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 引用了 87.5% 的第一档 oracle 位置，且它引用的每一行都属于 oracle 证据。
papers.abstractEn: As AI coding assistants generate more code, the need to review it for security flaws grows. Existing approaches leave a gap: static analyzers identify program sites but offer little explanation, while language-model explanations can be difficult to verify. Small open-weight code models could make security review available without sending proprietary code to a hosted service. We study whether fine-tuning helps these models turn security evidence into explanations that developers and tools can check. We present secSemScan, which pairs a static analyzer with a locally deployable model that writes a schema-constrained security monologue naming program sites, assigning a CWE, and giving a machine-parseable verdict. We also introduce OGSM (Oracle-Grounded Security Monologue), a dataset of 1,993 C/C++ functions covering 22 CWEs in the taint and lifetime families. Each record pairs a function with analyzer-derived or fix-diff-derived evidence and a monologue. We fine-tune three open-weight code models in two stages, first on the output format and then on the monologue content. Because evaluation prompts supply the verdict and evidence, our results measure how well models use that information, not whether they detect vulnerabilities independently. On 355 test records, fine-tuning raised Qwen2.5-Coder-7B's verdict accuracy from 4.8% to 96.6%; DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B reached 78.9%, and StarCoder2-7B reached 43.7%. Qwen2.5-Coder-7B cited 87.5% of Tier 1 oracle sites, and every line it cited belonged to the oracle evidence. The results suggest that fine-tuning helps small models produce more structured, evidence-linked security reasoning.

papers.title: Secure and Functional Code Generation with Self-Evaluation
papers.abstractOneWord: 推理时检索 CWE 知识生成既可用又安全的代码，对象是多语言程序。
papers.abstract: 大模型能写出功能正确但不安全的代码。面向安全的微调往往贵，也不总是有，因此需要推理时方法。面向安全的提示和检索能减少漏洞，但也可能删掉必要行为，或套上和任务不合的防护。难点在于找出相关安全知识，用它提高安全性，同时不牺牲功能。本文提出 SecGent：一个推理时框架，从 CWE 数据库检索弱点上下文，用于安全代码生成。它把任务说明连到相关的文本 CWE 记录，从而给出针对任务的安全指导，而不依赖检索到的漏洞或补丁代码示例。功能和安全测试共同检查实现，执行反馈引导修复同时满足这两个目标。作者在 CWEval 上用 4 个开源大模型和 Claude Sonnet 5.5、覆盖 5 种语言做了评测。对全部 5 个模型，SecGent 在功能和安全的联合成功率上都高于 4 个推理时基线。开源权重模型上，平均 functional-security@1（FS@1）比 RAG 高 15.5%，功能和安全都有提升；比每个模型最强的提示优化器高 19.8%。在 Sonnet 上 FS@1 达到 92.1%，比最强基线 AutoGen 高 4.8%。另一次对比中，SecGent 的 FS@1 比带安全提示的 Claude Code 高 6% 以上。带反馈的修复还能把无反馈生成的 FS@1 再提高最多 6.7%，主要是在检查安全的同时把功能找回来。
papers.abstractEn: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate functionally correct code that remains insecure. Security-focused fine-tuning can be expensive and is not always available, motivating inference-time approaches. Security-oriented prompting and retrieval can reduce vulnerabilities, but may also remove required behavior or apply defenses incompatible with the task. The challenge is to identify relevant security knowledge and use it to improve security without sacrificing functionality. We present SecGent, an inference-time framework that retrieves weakness context from the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) database and applies it to secure code generation. By connecting task specifications to relevant textual CWE records, SecGent provides task-specific security guidance without relying on retrieved vulnerable or patched code examples. Complementary functional and security tests check the resulting implementation, and their execution feedback guides repairs toward satisfying both objectives. We evaluate SecGent with four open-source LLMs and Claude Sonnet 5.5 across five programming languages on the CWEval benchmark. It achieves the highest joint functional--security success against four inference-time baselines for all five models. Across the open-weight models, mean functional-security@1 (FS@1) improves by 15.5% over RAG, with gains in both functionality and security, and by 19.8% over the strongest prompt optimizer compiled for each model. On Sonnet, FS@1 reaches 92.1%, outperforming the strongest baseline AutoGen by 4.8%. In a separate comparison, SecGent outperforms Claude Code with security-focused prompting by over 6% in FS@1. Feedback-guided repair further improves FS@1 by up to 6.7% over generation without feedback, primarily by recovering functionality while checking security.

papers.title: SymLift: Neural Semantic Lifting for Compile-Free Vulnerability Detection in Context-Incomplete Code Fragments
papers.abstractOneWord: 用微调大模型补全不完整代码片段的语义再做漏洞检测，不编译项目。
papers.abstract: 缺项目上下文时，依赖编译的分析器建不出漏洞检测所需的程序关系；单靠神经网络预测又给不出可审计的推导。本文提出 SymLift：一个面向漏洞的神经语义提升框架，用来处理上下文不完整的代码片段。微调后的大模型在受约束的类 LLVM 中间表示里重建与漏洞相关的控制流、数据流、内存和资源关系，但不重建完整项目上下文，也不直接预测漏洞标签。确定性解析器校验这份中间表示，并把支持的操作和关系映射成规范化证据事实。显式 Datalog 规则据此推出发现，并带上支撑事实和推导轨迹，对固定事实和规则保证确定性推理。作者在 FormAI、Juliet 和 MegaVul 上做了评测。把完整 Juliet 程序裁成函数级片段后，Clang 编译成功率从 100% 降到 12.00%，而 SymLift 的分析完成率只降 1.17 个百分点。任务微调后，提升器在 FormAI 上的控制流 IoU 达到 96.85%。SymLift-Qwen-7B 在 FormAI 上 Target-F1 为 94.41%；在 MegaVul 的 6 个漏洞族上，微平均精确率 98.24%，微平均 Target-F1 为 91.66%。
papers.abstractEn: Missing project context can prevent build-dependent analyzers from constructing program relations required for vulnerability detection, while neural predictions alone do not establish auditable derivations. We present SymLift, a compile-free framework centered on Vulnerability-Oriented Neural Semantic Lifting for context-incomplete code fragments. A fine-tuned large language model reconstructs vulnerability-relevant control-flow, data-flow, memory, and resource relations in a constrained LLVM-like intermediate representation (IR), without reconstructing the full project context or directly predicting vulnerability labels. A deterministic parser validates the IR and maps its supported operations and relations into normalized evidence facts. Explicit Datalog rules derive findings with supporting facts and derivation traces, ensuring deterministic reasoning for fixed facts and rules. We evaluate SymLift on FormAI, Juliet, and MegaVul. Reducing complete Juliet programs to function-level fragments lowers Clang compilation success from 100% to 12.00%, whereas SymLift's analysis completion rate decreases by only 1.17 percentage points. After task-specific fine-tuning, the lifter achieves a control-flow intersection over union (IoU) of 96.85% on FormAI. SymLift-Qwen-7B achieves a Target-F1 of 94.41% on FormAI and, across six vulnerability families on MegaVul, a micro-averaged precision of 98.24% and a micro-averaged Target-F1 of 91.66%. These results support accurate and auditable detection in the evaluated context-incomplete settings, even with partial program relations.

papers.title: Notes on BulletProofs++ Range Proofs
papers.abstractOneWord: 补全并修正 Bulletproofs++ 范围证明的规范与公式，没有用大模型。
papers.abstract: 本文重看 Bulletproofs++：它用十六进制数字上的倒数集合归属论证，替换了 Bulletproofs 里基于比特分解的内积论证。作者给出 64 比特范围证明的自包含规范，以及按批次大小 M 和位宽 b 参数化的一般批量变体，并证明诚实验证者零知识和精确形式的知识可靠性。他们描述了在 Ristretto255 上的 Rust 实现与优化：证明最多比常规 Bulletproofs 快 7.8 倍，验证最多快 4.5 倍。最后修正了原文两个公式：标量多项式 p_s(T) 的仿射 T^3 项应带因子 2，盲化向量 r_S 的 0 号分量符号应相反。
papers.abstractEn: We review the Bulletproofs++ construction which replaces the bit-decomposition inner-product argument of Bulletproofs with a reciprocal set-membership argument over base-16 digits. We present a self-contained specification of the 64-bit range proof as well as a general batched variant parametric in the batch size M and bit width b and prove honest-verifier zero-knowledge and exact-form knowledge soundness. We describe the evaluation and optimizations of our Rust implementation over Ristretto255, which proves up to 7.8x and verifies up to 4.5x faster than regular Bulletproofs. Finally, we correct two formulas of the original paper: the affine T^3 term of the scalar polynomial p_s(T) carries a factor of 2, and the slot-0 component of the blinding vector r_S carries the opposite sign.

papers.title: Mikros: Bitwidth-Aware SNARKs over Extensions of Small Fields
papers.abstractOneWord: 按见证位宽构造端到端 SNARK，没有用大模型。
papers.abstract: SNARK 证明者为了可靠性要在大域上做算术，即使见证项只有几比特宽，这会抬高证明时间和内存。近期工作让单个 SNARK 组件感知位宽，见证更窄就更快、更省内存，但这些技术只覆盖证明者的一部分，并且常依赖特定域结构，尤其是二元域。本文提出 Mikros：一个基于代数向量打包的端到端位宽感知 SNARK 框架。它把基域 F 上长度为 N=mκ 的向量打包成次数为 κ 的扩域 E 上长度为 m 的向量，从而把 F 上长度为 N 的关系变成 E 上长度为 m 的关系，并让已有的线性时间扩域协议感知位宽。这一技术统一了此前分开得到的位宽感知内积证明、Hadamard 积证明和多项式承诺，并给出第一个位宽感知大积证明，从而给出第一个位宽感知置换论证。把它们组合起来，就得到任意小域扩域上电路可满足性的位宽感知 SNARK。单个电路实例的证明代价与有效位宽成正比（见证项位宽加上布线位置编码位宽）；同一电路的多个实例可以分摊位置编码，每个实例代价与见证位宽成正比。Mikros 不依赖二元域结构，但在 256 次 SHA-256 压缩、Keccak 置换和 BLAKE3 压缩的批次上，证明者分别比目前二元扩域上最好的位宽感知 SNARK Flock 快 2.19 倍、2.55 倍和 1.85 倍。
papers.abstractEn: Provers for succinct non-interactive arguments of knowledge (SNARKs) perform arithmetic over a large field for soundness, even when the witness entries are a few bits wide, which inflates both prover time and memory usage. Recent work makes individual SNARK components bitwidth-aware, so that a lower witness bitwidth means faster proving and lower memory usage, but these techniques cover only part of the prover and exploit the structure of specific fields, typically binary ones. We introduce Mikros, a framework for end-to-end bitwidth-aware SNARK construction based on algebraic vector packing. We pack vectors of length N=mκ over a base field F into length-m vectors over a degree-κ extension field E, which turns length-N relations over F into length-m relations over E and makes existing linear-time extension-field protocols bitwidth-aware. This technique thus unifies bitwidth-aware inner-product proofs, Hadamard-product proofs, and polynomial commitment schemes, previously obtained by separate constructions, and yields the first bitwidth-aware grand-product proof, hence the first bitwidth-aware permutation argument. Composing them gives bitwidth-aware SNARKs for circuit satisfiability over extensions of arbitrary small fields. For a single instance of circuit satisfiability, the prover cost is proportional to the effective bitwidth, the combined bitwidth of the witness entries and the wiring-position encodings; across instances of the same circuit, the position encoding is amortized and the per-instance cost is proportional to the witness bitwidth. Although Mikros does not rely on binary-field structure, its prover is 2.19x, 2.55x, and 1.85x faster on batches of 256 SHA-256 compressions, Keccak permutations, and BLAKE3 compressions than Flock (Bunz et al., IACR ePrint 2026), the state-of-the-art bitwidth-aware SNARK over binary-extension fields.

papers.title: Strongly Adaptive Asynchronous Byzantine Agreement with Linear Communication and Almost-Everywhere Termination
papers.abstractOneWord: 在强自适应异步网络里做近处处终止的拜占庭共识，没有用大模型。
papers.abstract: 面对可腐化 t=Θ(n) 个参与方、并在腐化时撤回未送达消息的强自适应对手，拜占庭共识需要 Ω(t²) 条消息，这是已知下界。本文放松终止条件来绕开它：对任意常数 0<ν<1，至少 (1-ν) 比例的诚实方会终止，而一致性和有效性对每个诚实决定都成立。对每个常数腐化间隙 δ>0 以及每个 t≤(1-δ)n/3，作者在带认证的异步网络中构造了满足上述保证的二元共识，能对抗带消息撤回的强自适应腐化。除可忽略概率外，这些保证成立，且每个诚实决定都带可转发的证明。协议在期望 O(1) 轮内近处处终止，期望总通信 O(nκ²) 比特，腐化前诚实方的期望最大通信是 Õ(κ²) 比特，其中 κ 是计算安全参数。构造把递归共享的 BLS 签名密钥和稀疏图上的证书扩散结合起来：递归共享用来实现安全阈值和活性阈值不同的门限签名，扩散则把已有证书传到几乎所有诚实方。方案需要可信设置，并在随机预言机模型下、代数单次更多计算 Diffie–Hellman 假设上安全。对不撤回消息的自适应腐化，他们还得到同样渐近通信和轮复杂度的完整二元共识，且不要求原子多发或私密信道。
papers.abstractEn: It is well known that Byzantine agreement requires Ω(t²) messages against a strongly adaptive adversary that may corrupt t=Θ(n) parties and suppress a party's undelivered messages upon corruption. We circumvent this lower bound by relaxing termination: for any constant 0<ν<1, at least a (1-ν) fraction of the honest parties terminate, while agreement and validity hold for every honest decision. For every constant corruption gap δ>0 and every t≤(1-δ)n/3, we construct binary agreement with this guarantee in authenticated asynchronous networks against strongly adaptive corruptions with message takebacks. Except with negligible probability, these guarantees hold and every honest decision carries a transferable justifier. The protocol achieves almost-everywhere termination in expected O(1) rounds, expected total communication O(nκ²) bits, and expected maximum communication Õ(κ²) bits over honest parties before corruption, where κ is the computational security parameter. Our construction combines a recursively shared BLS signing key with certificate dissemination over a sparse graph. The recursive sharing is used to implement threshold signing with distinct safety and liveness thresholds. Dissemination propagates existing certificates to almost all honest parties. The construction uses a trusted setup and is secure in the random oracle model under the algebraic one-more computational Diffie--Hellman assumption. We further obtain full binary agreement with the same asymptotic communication and round complexity against adaptive corruptions without message takebacks. The extension requires neither atomic multi-send nor private communication channels.
